summary.oneLiner: Manufacturer of pharmaceuticals with an additional renewable energy segment.
summary.business: The Company continues to operate in the manufacturing of pharmaceuticals segment and a renewable energy segment. During FY 2025-26 net sales grew across both exports and domestic markets, which management attributed to sustained demand, operational efficiency and cost management.

currentContext.strategies: Maintains a diversified pharmaceutical product portfolio|Focuses on manufacturing excellence through quality systems and compliant production for domestic and international partners|Operates a dedicated R&D centre focused on formulation development and improving operational efficiency
currentContext.expansion: The Company owns two wind turbines at Jaisalmer, Rajasthan with a combined capacity of 1.6 MW; the electricity generated is sold on the Indian Energy Exchange. No new capex or expansion project with a commissioning/completion timeline was disclosed in this section.
currentContext.mdna: Rising demand for prescription medicines fuelled by increasing prevalence of chronic and lifestyle-related conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular disorders, obesity and CNS disorders|Structural shift in the Indian healthcare market towards preventive healthcare, wellness, specialized therapeutics and digitally enabled healthcare services|Rising disposable incomes, increasing healthcare awareness, expanding insurance penetration and favourable demographics expected to continue strengthening the pharmaceutical industry|China-plus-one shift seen as a significant opportunity for India to become a preferred pharmaceutical manufacturing destination and capture a growing share of global outsourcing|Management flags geopolitical frictions, tariff volatility, supply chain dependencies, regulatory constraints, pricing pressures and rising input-cost inflation as ongoing causes of concern

risks.note: The Company states it does not consume large quantities of commodities in its manufacturing activities and therefore is not materially exposed to commodity price risk, and it does not undertake any commodity hedging — leaving exposure unmitigated if that reliance changes.
